subject: Security intake: SOC2 TII artifacts, bridge letter & TrustPortal onboarding for AuraNet
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@auranet.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: SOC2 TII artifacts, bridge letter & TrustPortal onboarding for AuraNet

Hi Elena / AuraNet team — thanks again for a productive demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations on the security intake: 

Recap from call:
- AuraNet is evaluating Redwood for inference workloads (latency-sensitive routing + dataset isolation).
- Primary security asks: SOC 2 Type II report, a short bridge letter confirming no scope changes since the report, and access to a TrustPortal or SFTP where artifacts can be exchanged.
- AuraNet also requested we initiate the vendor security questionnaire (DSQ/DDQ) so their InfoSec team can triage controls mapping.

Our asks / proposed path forward:
1) We will provide a redacted copy of our latest SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood Inference SOC2 TII 2027) plus a one-page bridge letter clarifying the report window and unchanged control scope.
2) Please provide the TrustPortal account email(s) or an SFTP endpoint where we can securely upload the artifacts. If you prefer a portal invite, we typically request permission for one or two reviewer emails.
3) Attached is our standard vendor intake (DSQ starter) — let us know if you want us to pre-fill any sections before handing off to your team.
4) Target timeline: deliver redacted SOC2 + bridge letter by Oct 19 so AuraNet InfoSec can review ahead of the procurement kickoff on Oct 24. If you need an accelerated path, we can prioritise.

Attachments: AuraNet_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx (blank — please confirm whether you want us to pre-populate)

Action items:
- Elena: confirm preferred artifact transfer method (TrustPortal invite or SFTP) and reviewer emails.
- Marissa: will prepare redacted SOC2 + bridge letter draft for internal review once Elena confirms transfer method.
- Jordan/Karthik: will collate answers for the DSQ if AuraNet wants us to pre-fill.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference (attachments referenced: vendor intake template)

From: Elena Morris <elena@auranet.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC2 TII artifacts, bridge letter & TrustPortal onboarding for AuraNet

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Portal vs SFTP: TrustPortal is preferred (centralized evidence tracking). We can send an invite if you provide the reviewer emails; otherwise SFTP works as a fallback.
- Redaction policy: We accept redacted reports provided the attestation page (signature + opinion) and control descriptions remain intact. We cannot accept a report missing the testing period.
- DSQ: we attached a short vendor intake (we filled basic company fields). If you can pre-populate the technical controls section, our team will review faster.

I attached the file we initially filled: AuraNet_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx (we put our intake fields in tab 'Aur aNet Intake').

For portal invites, please provide the email(s) for your reviewers. If you need a single contact, security@auranet.io is the main InfoSec queue (we will then assign reviewers internally).

Also — we require a small proof-of-possession step for the portal (one-time link will be issued). If you prefer SFTP, we will send SFTP credentials and an upload path.

Would it be possible to aim for Oct 20 review readiness on your side? If so, we can schedule a short 20-minute follow-up on Oct 21 to walk through any control gaps.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Security Program Manager
AuraNet
elena@auranet.io

Attachments: AuraNet_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@auranet.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Oct 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC2 TII artifacts, bridge letter & TrustPortal onboarding for AuraNet

Thanks Elena — helpful. We can meet the Oct 20 readiness target with the following internal plan: 

- Marissa will produce a redacted PDF of our SOC2 TII report and a concise bridge letter (1 page) by COB Oct 18 for internal review.
- Karthik / I will pre-fill the technical controls section of the intake where possible and return the DSQ to you by Oct 18.
- Request for Elena: please confirm which reviewer email(s) we should use for the TrustPortal invite (security@auranet.io is fine, but if you prefer a named reviewer please share their email).

Internal note (Marissa): please prepare two artifact versions — one fully redacted for broad distribution and one with limited redactions for official reviewers. Mark clearly which fields to remove.

We plan to upload artifacts to your TrustPortal link if provided; otherwise we'll use Redwood's secure S3 transfer (we'll provide a pre-signed upload link).

Karthik — happy to have you lead vendor Q&A if Aurora's team asks for clarifications.

-Jordan

Hi Karthik / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We went ahead and issued a TrustPortal invite to security@auranet.io and to "redwood-security@auranet-access" (temporary reviewer account) so you should receive an automated invite link shortly. Portal link: https://trust.auranet.io/invite/6a2f9b

Please note the following: 
- The portal will accept password-protected ZIP archives and PDFs (please include a separate email with the decryption password).
- Our reviewers prefer a single PDF bundle for the SOC2 plus a separate single-page bridge letter.
- We attached a portal invite stub for your records: TrustPortal_Invite-auranet-20281013.url

We also added a short DSQ worksheet to the portal and pre-populated our intake answers; if you upload your pre-filled technical controls, we will sync and assign reviewers within 24 hours.

If you'd like, I can schedule a 20-minute sync for Oct 21 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the DSQ and any control clarifications. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Security Program Manager
AuraNet
